paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 51:9, where Rabbi Yudan of Galui and Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman speak in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Midrash Rabbah — TE Bereshit Rabbah 51:9 paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Yudan of Galui and Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman both speaking in the name of Rabbi Elyehoeinai. The reporting direction and the two corresponding full titles in the body are supported locally. The source’s untitled heading is retained and no further teaching or figure is imported.
